task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel LSV benchmark chart, variant 05. Scenario: raw versus iR-corrected LSV.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel linear sweep voltammetry / polarization curve benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel figure. No explicit panel letter is printed inside the image, so the task target was matched to the only visible panel. The saved crop conservatively preserves the full axis labels and legend. Anchor pixels were taken from visible tick-mark centers in original-figure coordinates, and the fit utility validated both axes as linear.

response.interpretation_notes: Main plot contains three monotonic LSV-style traces matching the legend. Candidate points were taken from per-curve stroke columns inside the anchored plot area only.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.
